Forcing individuals to remain in an unhealthy, unsatisfying relationship goes against basic human rights for happiness and personal fulfillment. Parties involved deserve autonomy over their personal lives and relationships, without infringement upon these choices.

text: I wholly agree to the topic
llm_text: I continue to firmly believe that divorce can be justified. Marriage should be based on love, trust, and commitment; however, if these elements have eroded beyond repair, it is essential for parties involved to part ways amicably and move forward with their lives. Forced unions serve neither the individuals nor society at large.
